records.Concise description: A 777-piece early Ordinals collection that evolved into the broader BTC Machine / Satoria game and community ecosystem.
records.Deeper researched summary: BTC Machine traces to a very early inscription era, with marketplace/index records placing an early collection inscription around #75,898. Its current project channels connect BTC Machine with Satoria MMORPG and ZBIT, showing that the brand remains active beyond the original 777 collectibles. The project is therefore classified ACTIVE rather than simply historical.
Creators / founders: Full founder roles require first-party clarification
records.Launch / history: 777-piece Ordinals collection from early 2023; later expanded into Satoria/ZBIT-linked community and game development.
records.Why it matters in the Ordinals ecosystem: BTC Machine shows how an early finite Ordinals collectible could become the identity layer for a longer-running game/community ecosystem.
records.Verification basis: Current official site/community channels plus indexer chronology.
Research notes / uncertainties: Exact individual founder roles remain unclear; avoid over-specific titles for Lucky/PAPO without first-party confirmation.

records.Concise description: A DMT/NAT collection by Evonbit whose cat traits are generated from Bitcoin block data rather than arbitrary trait assignment.
records.Deeper researched summary: Natcats is a flagship Digital Matter Theory implementation. Official documentation presents it as the first digital-art collection generated from Bitcoin block data and credits Evonbit as creator. Its first 8,064 works were free-minted in February 2024, while the DMT rule can allow additional Natcats when the relevant block-data pattern appears. The project later helped pioneer UNAT concepts.
Creators / founders: The Block Runner — DMT framework creator, related but not Natcats artist
records.Launch / history: First 8,064 Natcats were free-minted in February 2024; the deterministic DMT pattern can create future eligible occurrences depending on the standard’s rules.
records.Why it matters in the Ordinals ecosystem: Natcats is the clearest cultural/art demonstration of DMT’s non-arbitrary thesis and helped make block-data-derived digital assets understandable to collectors.
Important technical or cultural characte: Traits/supply derived from Bitcoin block data
Potential future eligibility under deterministic pattern
records.Verification basis: Current official Natcats documentation and DMT documentation.
Research notes / uncertainties: Do not present the initial 8,064 as a permanently fixed supply if the governing DMT pattern permits later eligible Natcats.

records.Concise description: King’s DMT-based Ordinals PFP collection using raw Bitcoin block data to generate 10,080 unique royal characters.
records.Deeper researched summary: The Royals extends DMT aesthetics into a large PFP system, with official creator material describing a May 2024 launch and raw Bitcoin data as the generative input. Current project channels identify 10,080 unique characters and remain active in 2026. The project should be linked to DMT/NAT rather than treated as a conventional randomized off-chain PFP generator.
records.Launch / history: Launched May 2024 as a DMT-driven PFP collection.
records.Why it matters in the Ordinals ecosystem: The Royals demonstrates how DMT block-data concepts can support a recognizable, large-scale character collection rather than only abstract token experiments.

Corroborating sources.label: The Block Runner podcast — King / The Royals

records.Verification basis: Current creator site/current project channels plus industry corroboration.

records.Concise description: A 100-piece early Ordinals PFP set inspired by CryptoPunks, with all works inscribed within roughly the first 650 inscription numbers.
records.Deeper researched summary: Ordinal Punks is one of the earliest recognizable coordinated PFP sets on Ordinals. It consists of 100 punk-style images and is commonly attributed to the pseudonymous FlowStay. Different historical indexes report slightly different exact inscription ranges because early numbering/indexing changed, so MSC should emphasize the stable fact: the collection sits within the first ~650 inscriptions.
records.Launch / history: Created in the first weeks of Ordinals in early 2023; 100 works inscribed within approximately the first 650 inscription numbers.
records.Why it matters in the Ordinals ecosystem: Its extremely early provenance made it a foundational reference for PFP collecting and the early rush to organize collections on Ordinals.
records.Verification basis: Project site plus current/historical Ordinals indexers.
Research notes / uncertainties: Exact range varies across historical indexing sources; use 'within the first ~650' unless a canonical current Ord index is locked.
Do not conflate with Bitcoin Punks (the later 10k collection).
